files.description: A 10 x 20 x 30 box whose BRep representation also lists a TESSELLATED_SOLID with TRIANGULATED_FACEs linked to the six ADVANCED_FACEs; ReadTessellated On and Off both put the file mesh on all six exact faces, OnNoBRep on none.
The same file with the tessellated solid dropped from the BRep representation items.

box-brep-only.step with one ADVANCED_FACE naming its AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D (#33) where its PLANE (#32) belongs. OCCT's transfer returns success with five faces; it records the fail 'Surface has not been created' against the unread (null) surface and only a warning on the face.
../ap242-radius1-height10.step without GLOBAL_UNCERTAINTY_ASSIGNED_CONTEXT, so the reader takes ReadPrecisionVal.
../edge-treatments/06-full-cylinder.step without GLOBAL_UNCERTAINTY_ASSIGNED_CONTEXT, so the reader takes ReadPrecisionVal.

../ap242-box.step without GLOBAL_UNCERTAINTY_ASSIGNED_CONTEXT and with LINE #27's point moved 5e-4 mm in x off its edge's vertices. Within ReadPrecisionVal 1e-3 the vertices absorb the offset; at the DESTEP_Parameters default 1e-4 the reader shifts the line, so the admitted tolerances differ.
